_metadata.description: Gene-level metadata used by the report generator, medications tab, and simplified star-allele caller. This file has no drug-level annotations in the underlying 1000 Genomes real-data pipeline, so drug/CPIC-level info here is sourced independently from CPIC.
_metadata.source: CPIC gene-drug pair table (cpicpgx.org) and PharmVar allele definitions (pharmvar.org).
_metadata.caller_disclaimer: The rsIDs listed here support ONLY the simplified demo star-allele caller in utils/star_allele_caller.py. They are not a complete or clinical-grade allele definition set; real star-allele calling requires the full PharmVar structural/haplotype definitions.

DPYD.india_relevance_note: DPYD poor-metaboliser genotypes carry a life-threatening fluoropyrimidine toxicity risk (severe neutropenia, mucositis, potentially fatal). This is why Seed classifies DPYD/NUDT15/TPMT poor-metaboliser phenotypes as clinical significance class 3 (Urgent) rather than class 2.

NUDT15.india_relevance_note: NUDT15 poor-metaboliser status is a major, often-underscreened cause of severe thiopurine-induced myelosuppression in South/East Asian patients; CPIC recommends genotyping alongside TPMT before starting thiopurines.

ABCG2.full_name: ATP Binding Cassette Subfamily G Member 2

IFNL3.india_relevance_note: IFNL3 genotype (rs12979860) predicts response to interferon-based hepatitis C therapy; less relevant with modern direct-acting antivirals but retained here for completeness of the CPIC gene panel used to build Seed's training set.

VKORC1.full_name: Vitamin K Epoxide Reductase Complex Subunit 1
VKORC1.india_relevance_note: VKORC1 is included in the CPIC gene panel Seed targets, but has zero usable training records in this dataset's South Asian subset -- every SAS VKORC1 call here is phenotype 'Indeterminate'. Seed discloses this rather than fabricating a score, and excludes VKORC1 from the app's selectable gene list until real SAS phenotype data becomes available.
